description: Public JSON Schema contract for where each authored document of a connector package sits, read from the package root, and the published schema a document at that location is written against: `definition/connector.json`, `definition/type-map.json` and `definition/endpoints/{endpoint_id}.json`. It holds locations only; each document's shape is the schema it points at. Source of truth: analitiq.contracts.connector_package.ConnectorPackage (Pydantic).
title: Analitiq Connector Package
